item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - [REQ AUD] Ariana Grande Acapellas and Instrumentals FLAC Compilation (Stems and Official)
item.description: Hello there! When looking up the Instrumentals / Karaoke section of the forum I've kept finding multiple Ariana Grande stems compilations. And I was so glad since I've been looking for any available non-filtered / studio acapella and instrumental versions of her music after the ones from eternal sunshine deluxe came out some months ago. However, all the stem posts only have each song / album in unmixed separate tracks and tbh I don't really have enough HD space to store all the individual stem files or time to manually mix every song's stems to get the acapella / instrumental. So can anyone please mix all the available Ariana Grande stems (from her discography + outside collabs / remixes where she's the feature) as acapellas and instrumentals (in FLAC ofc, though mp3s are fine if that's the only available version) and compile them in one pack / masterpost? It can even have the officially released acs/ins (like the aforementioned ESD, the My Everything singles and the Fortnite Festival stems) as well as alternate versions (like solo versions of collabs) and unreleased songs from other stems for a more complete collection. Btw, some other related posts like an older AG instrumental compilation and the acapella of the Die For You remix have links that have since been taken down. Also, iirc a handful of song stems only have the clean / non-explicit vocal or demo version so those acapellas should be labeled as such too. And if the post gets updated whenever new stems show up, that'd be really appreciated. Thanks a lot in advance.
